newsitem.title: USA: Illinois panel votes not to impeach judge.
newsitem.headline: Illinois panel votes not to impeach judge.

text.p: A panel of Illinois lawmakers on Thursday voted not to seek impeachment proceedings against state Supreme Court Justice James Heiple.
Heiple's admitted misdeeds in dealing arrogantly with police trying to serve him with traffic tickets were declared not serious enough to seek his impeachment, the panel's chairman said.
The committee voted 8-2 against impeachment, with the majority deciding that removal of the judge might also have set a precedent that could have compromised the independence of the judiciary.
Heiple resigned last month as chief justice but remained on the seven-member Illinois high court after a judiciary panel censured him for disreputable behaviour.
